constraints.text: the temple “is positioned upon the meeting of two rivers,” and a sophisticated aqueduct system channeled water from both rivers into the converging tunnels
constraints.reading: Hiding spot sits at or just above a confluence — where two streams/rivers meet (a fork, junction, or convergence of water channels). Look for a point of land overlooking or between two flowing waters.

constraints.text: a roaring sound grew louder toward the apex — audible even to people outside
constraints.reading: The spot may be near audible running/rushing water (rapids, falls, a loud confluence) — you would HEAR water, the sound getting stronger as you approach the high point.
Literal physical read: the access path CROSSES something — a road, bridge, railroad tracks, or stream. The hide is reached by crossing such a feature; check both directions at the crossing.

constraints.text: sitting at over 10,000 feet in the Andes ... a high-elevation setting ... built at the apex
constraints.reading: Spatial motif of a HIGH place — the feature/marker is at a height or apex, an elevated point reached by climbing toward a top.

constraints.text: Priests performed ceremonies on a roof reached by hidden stairs ... reached by hidden stairs
constraints.reading: A high platform/roof/overlook reached by a concealed or stepped route — think a ledge or flat top accessed by steps or a non-obvious climb.

constraints.text: a gigantic puzzle box [with] no discernible entrance ... led through a nondescript side entrance
constraints.reading: The actual entry/hiding point is non-obvious and off to the SIDE — not the apparent front. Look for a concealed side opening, gap, or crevice rather than the obvious face.

constraints.text: forty-five-foot walls (which feature massive carved heads protruding outward)
constraints.reading: Imagery of a tall vertical rock face/wall with protruding rounded knobs or boulders ('heads') jutting out — a cliff or outcrop with bulging rock features.

constraints.text: windowless narrow tunnels — some branching, some circling back, some dead ends ... single-file passageways
constraints.reading: Possible narrow passage/crevice/cave imagery — a tight single-file gap between rocks, with branching dead-end clefts. The right one is one of several similar narrow openings.

constraints.text: nails embedded in the walls to create sparkling reflections and mirrors hung as speculums
constraints.reading: Imagery of glinting/reflective material on a wall — a spot where light catches sparkling stone (mica/quartz) or a reflective surface.

constraints.text: their densely packed inscriptions “forced our visitor to lie on the ground to read them” / Raimondi Stele contour rivalry: reads differently right-side-up vs. upside-down
constraints.reading: Perspective hint — get LOW to the ground, or view the feature from an unexpected/inverted angle; the marker may only be readable from below or when seen the other way around.

constraints.text: remain “rooted onto the firm ground of reality”
constraints.reading: Possible literal nudge toward solid ground / a rooted feature (a tree base, firm rock footing) rather than water or loose terrain.

constraints.text: Gold Chavín drinking vessel / chalice — a hammered, decorated gold drinking vessel (a cup/goblet shape)
constraints.reading: Object shape: a chalice/cup — a rounded, concave, bowl-on-stem form. A landform echo could be a basin, hollow, bowl-shaped depression, or a cup-like rock cavity.

constraints.text: eagles, snakes, and cats ... raptorial birds, and snakes ... feline fangs
constraints.reading: Animal-shape imagery (bird/snake/cat) — a rock whose silhouette resembles one of these, or a sinuous snake-like ridge/path. Generic; treat as weak shape echo only.

constraints.text: his mother ran across the room and out the front church door
constraints.reading: Faint spatial imagery of crossing a space and exiting through a FRONT door/entrance — possibly reinforces the 'crossing' and 'front-facing entrance' motifs.
